name: Bhoj Bahadur Gharti Chhetri
aboutMe: Motivated Software Development and Network Engineering final-year student with hands-on academic and three-term co-op experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying full-stack web applications. Skilled in building responsive applications using Spring Boot and Angular for academic projects and developing MERN stack applications (MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js) during co-op placements, with deployments to cloud platforms. Proficient in JavaScript, RESTful API development, MySQL, MongoDB, Git, and Agile development practices. Fast learner and collaborative team member with experience contributing to software development, troubleshooting application issues, and delivering maintainable software solutions.
